# Upstream org fixtures

Real org files and expected outputs from Org mode's own test suite and
manual, org-transclusion's tests and org-roam's tests, used to check that
Mycelium reads and writes org as Emacs does. Each folder's `SOURCES.txt`
names the upstream file, URL and commit. They are GPL-3.0-or-later, like
Mycelium, and are used only by the tests (never shipped in the app).
